⚠️ Before You Buy HDFC ERGO Insurance — Please Read This

I raised a genuine motor claim after an accident, but the surveyor (Vikaram) submitted an incomplete and ego-based report without checking the vehicle properly.
HDFC ERGO then forcefully closed my claim and has been repeatedly shutting down my complaints, even after escalating to IRDA.

It’s clear they are more focused on protecting their surveyor and their internal mistakes than helping customers.

My honest advice after this experience:

❌ Don’t trust HDFC ERGO
❌ Don’t buy insurance from them
❌ They deny claims based on poor surveys
❌ They close complaints without resolution

Insurance is supposed to give support, not stress.
I’m still fighting for a genuine claim — and I don’t want anyone else to face this.

comments.text:
The scam of Bajaj Allianze car insurance:
Last year Nov, Papa had an accident got hit by truck, driver escaped and car was sent for insurance claim. We were thankful for Papa's life saved and were assured of getting our beloved vehicle repaired in the insurance claim as engine was intact and cabin too even after deployment of airbags. 
To our shock Surveyor declared our car total constructive loss and gave us the option to either submit the car and take IDV that was low(although choose by us) or if we want to retain the car IDV - Car Value = Insurance Claim that was only 63K. Later it was reduced to 43K stating that your car value in auction has increased (irony is a total loss car gaining on its value in the auction). 
We started to get calls from people to acquire our car as well in higher prices.
When I enquired to the surveyor he suggested that we either submit it for IDV or get it repaired from private mechanic and it will be done in around 60 k to 85k but nothing can be done on insurance. 
So here we are waiting on our car even after 4 months as it stands at private garage and missing on availability of certain parts.
Take : Car insurance companies are working for their profits so be alert in ensuring the maximum IDV and taking the policy attentively.
Companies can reject your claims on any grounds and so be ready.
Companies are running on a scam of acquiring the cars by increasing the repair cost beyond the 75% of IDV value, that gets your claim under the clause where your car is declared under total loss. No matter what.
Never go for cheap insurance by compromising on IDV values for a benefit of 1k or 2k. 
And don't blindly listen to the assurances of the dealer agents they are making their profits through commissions so they don't follow your concerns.
